overall_notes: The paper evaluates models on a sentence cloze completion task (selecting correct sentences to fill blanks), which qualifies as an NLG evaluation task. The extraction was generally good but missed the human evaluation aspect. Paper introduces SCDE dataset with teacher-designed distractors and compares model performance against human performance.
